title: 第2章  逐出族谱？地阶武脉！
content_zh:
青阳郡，青州九郡之一。
城门口，人来人往，热闹非凡。
方玄收敛了周身的气息，如同一个寻常的散修，缓步走入城中。
刚一进城，便听到路边的茶摊上传来阵阵议论声。
“听说了吗？方家那个傻子方玄，三天前坠崖死了！”
“死得好！一个傻子占着先天道体的名头，简直是浪费，而且还敢侮辱苏仙子，简直罪大恶极！”
“谁说不是呢？不过最厉害的还是问道宗弟子赵擎苍，听说他机缘巧合，觉醒了先天道体，如今已经被问道宗的长老收为亲传弟子，更要封其为问道宗圣子！”
阵阵议论声传入方玄的耳中，他的脚步微微一顿，眸中寒光闪烁。
侮辱苏清瑶？
先天道体觉醒？
好，好得很！
方玄嘴角的冷笑愈发浓郁，眼中杀机迸射。
方家，作为青阳郡的三大家族之一，在这青阳郡有着举足轻重的地位。
夕阳的余晖洒下，方家门口朱红的大门紧闭，门楣上“方府”二字在霞光映照下，透着几分威严，却也有些刺眼。
方玄缓缓走到门前，抬手轻轻叩响门环。
“谁啊？”
门内传出一个满是不耐烦的声音。
少顷，大门微启，露出一条缝隙，一个家丁探出头来。
瞧见方玄的瞬间，家丁先是一怔，紧接着脸色陡然剧变，失声惊呼：“你……你是方玄？你竟然没死？”
方玄神色平静，目光淡漠地看着家丁惊恐的面容，淡淡开口：“怎么？我没死，你很失望？”

家丁浑身一颤，忙不迭摇头：“不……不敢！只是……只是听闻您坠崖了……”
“我命硬，死不了。”
方玄言罢，径直伸手推开大门，欲跨步而入。
“你......你不能进去！”
家丁见状，赶忙阻拦，却被方玄反手一巴掌狠狠抽飞。
“欺主的狗奴才，谁给你的胆子！”
家丁满脸震惊，眼中尽是惶恐，再也不敢阻拦，只能战战兢兢地跟在方玄身后，心中暗自腹诽。
这白痴废物，何时变得如此强硬了？
此刻，方家议事厅内气氛凝重如铅。
“方玄此子，竟敢侮辱问道宗苏仙子，品行卑劣。我提议，即刻罢免方玄少主之位，移出族谱！”
方岳坐在议事厅主位上，缓缓开口，目光环视，颇具威严。
方玄的父亲方啸天在他年幼之时就已经失踪，母亲去世之后，方家的大权便落入了方玄的二叔方岳手中。
方岳此人，心胸狭隘，一直觊觎家主之位。
方玄痴傻的三年里，他没少苛待方玄，若非担心落人口舌，恐怕方玄早就被赶出方家了。
如今方玄一死，倒是为他省了不少事。
在方岳下方，数位方家长老正襟危坐，厅外则站满了方家族人。
罢免方玄？逐出族谱？
此提议一出，全场瞬间哗然。
众人早已知晓方玄身死的消息，只是未曾料到方岳竟如此迫不及待。
“二爷，即便少主已然身陨，可就这样将其移出族谱，于情于理都说不过去啊。”

下方，方家二长老方山河开口，声音沉稳却透着忧虑。
他看向方岳，神色凝重：“此事若传扬出去，定会遭人诟病，寒了族人们的心呐。”
虽说方玄痴傻三年，武脉阻塞，无法修行，但终究流淌着方家的血脉。
“二长老所言极是。”
三长老也跟着附和道：“我方家在青阳立足数百年，向来以仁义治家。无论是罢免少主之位，还是将其逐出族谱，皆非小事，还望各位慎重斟酌。”
听到这些话，方岳并不意外。
二长老和三长老皆是方啸天的心腹，即便方玄沦为废物，他们依旧坚信方啸天会归来。
两人的话，也让不少方家长老和族人暗自点头，皆觉方岳的提议过于无情，甚至有些卑劣。
“诸位不妨先瞧瞧这个。”
方岳说着，拿起一张婚书，向众人示意。
“这是......”
方山河面色骤变，“是少主和苏清瑶的婚书？”
“正是。”
方岳面色一黯，佯装出痛心疾首的模样，“方玄性情卑劣，竟对苏仙子动手动脚，意图强迫，以致失足落下断魂崖。这实在是令人痛心疾首之事。”
方山河的脸色愈发难看。
他本就怀疑方玄失足落崖乃苏清瑶一手策划。方玄本就痴傻，怎会前往断魂崖？苏清瑶自身修为不低，又怎会被方玄侮辱？
更何况，赵擎苍突然觉醒先天道体，哪有这般巧合之事？
这分明是栽赃陷害！
可他苦无证据。
“即便发生此等事，苏仙子宽宏大量，并未责怪方家，仅要求与方玄解除婚约。”

方岳接着说道：“但诸位都清楚，如今苏仙子已成功拜入问道宗，且与问道宗圣子情投意合。苏仙子不追究，难道那位赵圣子会善罢甘休？”
“正是为方家着想，我才提议将方玄逐出家族，斩断关联，如此方能保我方家平安无事。”
闻言，方山河眉头紧皱。
他虽可质疑方岳与苏清瑶，但对于问道宗，却万万不敢置疑。
那可是青州最为顶尖的宗门。
如今赵擎苍觉醒先天道体，被封为圣子，与苏清瑶堪称金童玉女，方玄的存在，无疑成了方家的一大污点。
“但方玄毕竟已离世，又何必做到如此地步？”
方山河面露不忍。
“正因他已死，我们才更需顾全大局。”
方岳神色冰冷，“为了一个死人，去冒得罪问道宗的风险，孰轻孰重，无需我再多言吧？”
此话一出，方山河到嘴边的话又咽了回去。
趁此机会，方岳紧接着道：“不仅如此，今日既然大家都在，便顺势选出新的少主吧。”
此言一出，恰似一石激起千层浪。
方山河赶忙道：“少主乃一族之希望，肩负家族使命，承担族中重任。如今我方家年轻一代中，恐怕无人能够担当此任。”
“谁说的？”
这时，一个略带戏谑的声音响起。
众人循声望去，只见一名锦衣少年，眉目如星，腰悬美玉，气质孤傲，正是方霄。
方霄，原本是方家仅次于方玄的天才，自三年前方玄变故后，便成为方家第一天才。
同时，他也是方岳的儿子。
见到方霄，方岳眼中精光一闪，略带期待地问道：“怎么样？”

“成了。”
方霄点头，脸上傲然之色更浓。
“好，好啊！”
方岳放声大笑，目光炯炯地看向众人，缓缓道：“诸位，吾儿方霄，承蒙先祖庇佑，觉醒地阶武脉，日后必能带领方家更上一层楼。”
“什么？”
“地阶武脉？”
众人听闻，无不大惊失色。
“嗡——”
就在众人震惊之际，方霄周身气血翻涌，一道道澎湃纹路自其体内喷薄而出，震得整个议事大厅微微颤抖。
无数族人体内武脉也随之微微震颤，恰似蝼蚁窥见真龙。
“好，天佑我方家啊！”
一直沉默的大长老方山海开口，“为方家计，即刻罢黜方玄少主之位，逐出族谱。弟子方霄，觉醒地阶武脉，当为少主，代表方家，参加一月后的三族大比。”
方啸天失踪后，方山海成为方家修为最强者，身为凝元境三品强者，他一切以家族利益为重。
谁对方家有用，便支持谁。
方山海一脸欣慰地看着方霄：“霄儿，这一个月，你只管专心修炼，一应修炼资源，家族全力提供。”
“多谢大长老，孙儿定不负家族重托。”
方霄傲然点头，目光睥睨四周，无人敢与之对视。
先前还摇摆不定的方家众人，见状纷纷起身祝贺。
“哈哈，二爷生了个好儿子啊，可喜可贺。”
“方霄贤侄不愧是我方家之龙，日后定能武道高升，扬我方家威风。”

“没了一个痴傻废物，却诞生了个武道天骄，我方家必定万世昌隆。”
一个个方家长老，一个个方家族人，仿佛全然忘却方玄，纷纷围在方霄身边，满是恭维。
武道修行，武脉为尊。
废脉者如虫蚁，难以修行；神血者如真龙，可翱翔九天。
地阶武脉虽比不上先天道体，但也是万中无一的天才资质。倘若机缘造化足够，未来成就未必逊色于先天道体。
从今往后，众人都要仰仗方霄，乃至方岳。
“现在，我以方家少主身份，宣布一事。”
方霄开口，众人顿时神情肃穆，凝神倾听。
“方玄冒犯问道宗弟子，有辱门风。现本少主宣布，将其所有物品尽数焚烧，其父其母教子无方，所立衣冠冢也移出祖地，以儆效尤。”
方啸天失踪多年，族人皆以为他已死，便为他立了衣冠冢。
如今，方霄却要将其衣冠冢移出祖地，也是为了告诉众人。
从今往后，方家以他为尊。
“凭什么？”
这时，一道清脆却固执的声音突然响起。
只见一名少女，走进议事大厅，愤怒的看着众人。
少女身材瘦小，脸色蜡黄，一脸就是营养不良，体魄天生虚弱。
她叫方柔，是方玄的妹妹。
面对满屋强者，毫无修为的方柔双眼通红，鼓起勇气说道：“我哥为了方家，付出心血，如今他只是失踪，你们凭什么认为他死了？还要抢走他的少主之位？”
少女的语气，掷地有声，质问一众长老。
方柔扑通一声跪在大长老面前，以头抢地，提高声音说道：“我方柔，今日恳请大长老，为我哥哥方玄，主持公道！”

“小贱人，这里是家族重地，谁让你进来的？”
一名少年从人群中冲出，一脚踹翻方柔，满脸狠意。
“大长老，求求您了。”
方柔继续磕头，额头鲜血染红地面，满脸哀求，“我哥哥是被人陷害的，他绝对不会做出那些事情，请......”
“闭嘴！”
方岳目露杀意，厉声喝道：“被人陷害？你是在质疑苏仙子和问道宗的赵圣子吗！家族重地，岂是你女子能擅入的？霄儿，按族规，该如何处置？”
“打断四肢，关进水牢！”
此话一出，不少方家人不禁打了个寒颤。
方家水牢，暗无天日，常年弥漫阴寒之气，不仅消磨血肉，更折磨神魂。
被关之人，无不承受生不如死之痛。
“怎么？少家主的命令都没人执行了？”
方岳冷冷一喝，“拖下去！”
“我来！”
正是先前将方柔踹翻的方志，他本是方家旁支，以前是方玄的跟班。后来方玄天才陨落，他便转而投靠方霄。
“小贱人，你跟你那个废物哥哥，一样令人讨厌。”
方志面色狰狞，抬脚狠狠踩向方柔。
“敢动我妹妹，你找死！”
就在此时，一声冷喝如雷霆般炸响。
只见方玄大步流星而来，周身散发着彻骨的杀意。
尤其是看到妹妹那狼狈模样，方玄眼中寒意更甚。

母亲去世后，他和妹妹方柔相依为命。
特别是在他痴傻的三年里，妹妹悉心照顾着他，从未懈怠，也从未嫌弃过。
妹妹，就是方玄的逆鳞。
龙有逆鳞，触之即死！
“方玄？”
方志瞳孔骤缩，满脸震惊，“你……你居然还活着？但那又怎样？你就算活着，也不过是个废物！”
“这小贱人冒犯少主，触犯族规，我不仅要废了他，更要杀了他！”
说罢，方志一脚恶狠狠地踹向方柔的脑袋。
这一脚势大力沉，若踹实了，方柔绝无生机。
“你、找、死！”
方志只觉眼前黑影一闪，一道身影如鬼魅般疾冲而来，霸道凌厉的掌风裹挟着千钧之力，狠狠轰在他的胸膛。
“噗嗤——”
方志如遭雷击，身形高高飞起，随后重重摔落地面。
紧接着，他身体一阵抽搐，脑袋一歪，便彻底没了气息。
霎时间，整个议事大厅安静得针落可闻。
content_en:
Qingyang County is one of the nine counties in Qingzhou.
At the gate of the city, people were coming and going, and it was very lively.
Fang Xuan calmed down the aura around him and walked slowly into the city like an ordinary casual cultivator.
As soon as we entered the city, we heard a lot of chatter coming from the tea stalls on the roadside.
"Have you heard? That fool Fang Xuan from the Fang family fell off a cliff and died three days ago!"
"Have a good death! It's such a waste for a fool to occupy the title of Innate Dao Body, and he dares to insult Fairy Su, which is a heinous crime!"
"Who says otherwise? But the most powerful one is Taoist Sect disciple Zhao Qingcang. I heard that by chance, he awakened the innate Taoist body. Now he has been accepted as a direct disciple by the Taoist Sect elders, and he is even called the Holy Son of the Taoist Sect!"
Waves of discussion reached Fang Xuan's ears. His steps paused slightly and a cold light flashed in his eyes.
Insult Su Qingyao?
The innate Tao body awakens?
Good, very good!
The sneer at the corner of Fang Xuan's mouth became more intense, and murderous intent burst out in his eyes.
The Fang family, as one of the three major families in Qingyang County, plays a very important role in Qingyang County.
The afterglow of the setting sun shone down, and the vermilion door at the entrance of Fang's house was closed tightly. The word "Fang Mansion" on the lintel looked a bit majestic but also a bit dazzling under the glow of the sun.
Fang Xuan slowly walked to the door, raised his hand and knocked on the door knocker gently.
"Who?"
An impatient voice came from the door.
After a while, the door opened slightly, revealing a gap, and a servant stuck his head out.
The moment he saw Fang Xuan, the servant was startled at first, and then his expression suddenly changed, and he exclaimed: "You... you are Fang Xuan? You are not dead?"
Fang Xuan looked calm, looking at the frightened face of his servant with indifferent eyes, and said calmly: "What? I'm not dead, are you disappointed?"
The servant trembled all over and shook his head hastily: "No... I don't dare! It's just... I just heard that you fell off the cliff..."
"I am determined to die."
After Fang Xuan finished speaking, he reached out and pushed open the door, wanting to step in.
"You...you can't go in!"
Seeing this, the servant hurriedly stopped him, but was severely slapped away by Fang Xuan.
"You bully dog slave, who gave you the courage?"
The servant's face was shocked and his eyes were full of fear. He no longer dared to stop him and could only follow Fang Xuan tremblingly, cursing secretly in his heart.
When did this idiot trash become so tough?
At this moment, the atmosphere in the Fang family meeting hall was as solemn as lead.
"This son, Fang Xuan, dares to insult Fairy Su of Taoist Sect. His conduct is despicable. I propose that Young Master Fang Xuan be removed from the family tree immediately!"
Fang Yue sat in the main seat of the meeting hall, spoke slowly, and looked around with dignity.
Fang Xuan's father Fang Xiaotian disappeared when he was young. After his mother passed away, the power of the Fang family fell into the hands of Fang Xuan's second uncle Fang Yue.
Fang Yue is a narrow-minded person who has always coveted the position of the head of the family.
During the three years when Fang Xuan was stupid, he treated Fang Xuan harshly. If he wasn't worried about being criticized, Fang Xuan would have been kicked out of the Fang family long ago.
Now that Fang Xuan is dead, it saves him a lot of trouble.
Below Fang Yue, several Fang family elders were sitting upright, while outside the hall, people from the Fang family were standing.
Remove Fang Xuan? Expelled from the family tree?
As soon as this suggestion came out, the whole place was in an uproar.
Everyone already knew the news of Fang Xuan's death, but they never expected that Fang Yue would be so impatient.
"Second Master, even if the young master has died, it is unjustifiable both emotionally and rationally to remove him from the family tree like this."
Below, Fang Shanhe, the second elder of the Fang family, spoke, his voice calm but filled with worry.
He looked at Fang Yue with a solemn expression: "If this matter spreads, it will definitely be criticized by others and chill the hearts of the clan members."
Although Fang Xuan had been stupid for three years and his martial arteries were blocked and he was unable to practice, the blood of the Fang family flowed after all.
"What the second elder said is absolutely true."
The third elder also echoed: "Our Fang family has been based in Qingyang for hundreds of years and has always governed the family with benevolence and righteousness. Whether it is to remove the young master from the position or to generalHis expulsion from the family tree is no small matter, and I hope you will consider it carefully. "
Fang Yue was not surprised when he heard these words.
The second elder and the third elder are both Fang Xiaotian's confidants. Even if Fang Xuan becomes a waste, they still firmly believe that Fang Xiaotian will return.
The words of the two people also made many Fang family elders and clan members nod secretly. They all felt that Fang Yue's proposal was too ruthless and even a little despicable.
"You might as well take a look at this first. "
Fang Yue said, picked up a marriage certificate and signaled to everyone.
"This is..."
Fang Shanhe's expression suddenly changed, "Is it the marriage certificate between the young master and Su Qingyao? "
"Exactly. "
Fang Yue's face darkened, and he pretended to be distressed, "Fang Xuan had a despicable temperament, and actually touched Fairy Su with the intention of forcing her, causing her to slip and fall down the Soul-Desolating Cliff. This is really heartbreaking. "
Fang Shanhe's face became increasingly ugly.
He originally suspected that Su Qingyao planned Fang Xuan's mistake. Fang Xuan is stupid, how could he go to Soul-Desolating Cliff? Su Qingyao's own cultivation level is not low, how could she be insulted by Fang Xuan?
What's more, Zhao Qingcang suddenly awakened his innate Taoist body. How could it be such a coincidence?
This is clearly a frame-up!
But he has no evidence.
"Even if this happened, Fairy Su was magnanimous and did not blame the Fang family, but only asked to terminate the engagement with Fang Xuan. "
Fang Yue continued: "But everyone knows that now Fairy Su has successfully joined the Taoist Sect and is in love with the Holy Son of the Taoist Sect. If Fairy Su doesn't pursue the matter, will Saint Zhao give up? "
"It is for the sake of the Fang family that I proposed to expel Fang Xuan from the family and cut off the connection, so that we can keep our Fang family safe. "
Hearing this, Fang Shanhe frowned.
Although he could question Fang Yue and Su Qingyao, he never dared to question Taoism.
That was the top sect in Qingzhou.
Now that Zhao Qingcang has awakened his innate Taoist body and been named the Holy Son, he and Su Qingyao are called the golden boy. Fang Xuan's existence has undoubtedly become a big stain on the Fang family.
"But Fang Xuan has passed away after all, so why would he go to such an extent? "
Fang Shanhe couldn't bear it.
"Because he is dead, we need to take care of the overall situation even more. "
Fang Yue's expression was cold, "For the sake of a dead man, taking the risk of offending the Taoist Sect, which one is more serious, I don't need to say more, right?" "
As soon as these words came out, Fang Shanhe swallowed back the words that came to his lips.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Fang Yue immediately said: "Not only that, since everyone is here today, let's take advantage of the opportunity to elect a new young master. "
As soon as these words were spoken, it was like a stone that stirred up a thousand waves.
Fang Shanhe hurriedly said: "The young master is the hope of the clan, shouldering the family's mission and shouldering the important responsibilities of the clan. Nowadays, among the younger generation of our family, I am afraid that no one can take on this responsibility. "
"Who said that? "
At this time, a slightly joking voice sounded.
Everyone looked around and saw a young man in brocade clothes, with eyebrows like stars, jade hanging from his waist, and an aloof temperament. He was Fang Xiao.
Fang Xiao was originally the genius of the Fang family second only to Fang Xuan. After the incident of Xuan Xuan three years ago, he became the number one genius of the Fang family.
At the same time, he is also Fang Yue's son.
Seeing Fang Xiao, Fang Yue's eyes flashed and he asked with a little expectancy: "How is it? "
"It's done. "
Fang Xiao nodded, the look of pride on his face getting thicker.
"Okay, okay! "
Fang Yue laughed loudly, looked at everyone with piercing eyes, and said slowly: "Everyone, my son Fang Xiao, with the blessing of his ancestors, has awakened the earth-level martial arts, and will surely lead the Fang family to a higher level in the future. "
